context: Still unverified: the CUDA path and the Windows launcher. This host has no NVIDIA GPU and no Windows.
decisions: The unsloth/embeddinggemma-2 repository was evaluated and rejected as a runtime source: it publishes safetensors with no GGUF and no projector, so it cannot serve the portable llama.cpp runtime; ggml-org supplies the Q8_0 GGUF pair that was already pinned
No neural reranker was added: the operator requires speed and BM25-light stays the production family

done: Closed the GPU-verification gap on the operator host: Vulkan is installed (AMD RADV RENOIR integrated GPU, 512 MiB carve-out). The device is detected, the runtime offloads to it, and text/image/audio/video all return valid 768-dim unit-norm vectors
Verified the CPU-Vulkan parity gate on real hardware: cosine 0.999911 to 0.999953 against a 0.995 gate

Implemented the plan's 1.10x throughput gate: the launcher now measures the CPU baseline and every validated GPU candidate and rejects a GPU that works but is slower. On this host the Vulkan profile measured 0.72x and was correctly rejected
Fixed the device memory parser to use the FREE figure llama.cpp reports (32334 MiB, 30768 MiB free) instead of the total

Verified the whole deployment end to end on this host: the launcher selected the CPU profile, the stack reported ready, and an MCP project.search returned a real Gemma 2 Q8_0 result carrying the rerank score and rank

resume.next_action: Commit the working tree and publish the production image; the deployment kit and the new MCP tools must reach an operator before the automatic backend selection and the LLM Wiki can be used.
